maria_cs: Quick weekly check — EmberPay prefetch + batching snapshot (7d window).

maria_cs: Topline numbers: avg batch size 5.7, median batch latency 140ms, batch hit rate 38%, cost per 1k tokens $2.85.

devon_se: Noted. p95 latency spikes yesterday around 15:00 UTC, correlates with a few model fallbacks.

leo_ops: I see matching alerts in infra — KV cache miss rate jumped ~3x at the same time.

leo_ops: Logs snippet:
```
[2024-06-28T15:02:13Z] svc-infer: cache_miss key=user:prefetch:abcd1234
[2024-06-28T15:02:13Z] svc-infer: fallback to small-model v1.1
[2024-06-28T15:02:14Z] svc-infer: batch_size=2 latency=420ms
```

aj_customer_success: EmberPay PM flagged monthly spend up ~18% MoM. They're worried about tokens. Any quick mitigations?

maria_cs: Recommendations: 1) Increase prefetch window from 2s -> 5s for EmberPay interactive flows (expect higher hit rate). 2) Enable small-batch aggregation (200ms idle) to push avg batch to ~7. 3) Add hit-rate alert at 25% with paging. 4) Run a short A/B with quantized v1.3 to reduce per-token cost.

devon_se: I'll wire up the small-batch aggregation and the prefetch delta in staging. Added rollout config (branch: `prefetch-opt-emberpay`, commit `abc1234`).

maria_cs: ETA for staging smoke?

devon_se: Smoke tests this afternoon, will post results by 2024-06-29 09:00 UTC.

emberpay_pm: Good — please call out any user-visible changes so I can prep CS notes.

maria_cs: User-facing notes: no change to UX, maybe slightly faster responses; we'll mention 'background optimizations to reduce latency and costs'.

leo_ops: If caching hit rate reaches 50% we estimate ~10-15% cost reduction and p95 latency down ~20-30ms based on current traffic mix.

infra_bot: Deploy succeeded: rollout/prefetch-opt-emberpay @1719504600 (canary 10%).

aj_customer_success: I'll schedule enablement with EmberPay PM Monday and share expected cost delta.

maria_cs: Thanks — I'll monitor hit rate and batch size and post updated numbers next Tue. :thumbsup:
